_comment: Scenario skeletons (#1546, [D324]-[D327]): per cell of docs/scenarios/scenarios.json the ordered stages, the shared command/core each stage calls, and the hook points where a job's small scripts plug in. Human view: docs/agents/SKELETONS.md (index) + docs/agents/SKELETONS-stages.md (stage tables); `trail` = the route/card a cell reads right after its block (one door, #1895). Checked by tools/architecture/skeleton_guard.py and tests/test_skeletons_1546.py. entry_defs = public function names defined in the stage owners (a job script that defines one re-implements the stage); dup_rules = duplicate_guard rules owned by the stage. gap = no shared implementation (one line); a job may fill a gap stage with a hook at point 'gap'.

npm-ids.ru: ID из ячеек атласа при отсутствии npm_table.json
npm-ids.calls: agr npm-ids SOURCE NEW_OUT --profile facade (skip only when npm_table.json exists)

npm-udim-fit.ru: Stop gate: один UDIM на ID при 512-1706 px/m
npm-udim-fit.calls: npm2vpm_core.udim_fit_gate(mesh, atlas_wh) before any conversion write; non-fit stops for explicit policy

npm-to-vpm.ru: НПМ -> ВПМ, regions или correspondence table
npm-to-vpm.calls: AGR Tools npm.to_vpm / npm2vpm_core.plan(mode=regions; mode=table when npm_table.json exists)

maf-segments.gap: Manual source-bound edit on a copy; preserve UV seams and interfaces; measure silhouette deviation and instance-weighted triangle delta

maf-texture-class.gap: Manual per-finish evidence: true solid -> 256 stub; non-uniform or cut-out -> full-size candidate; missing or ambiguous finish blocks

maf-atlas-strategy.gap: Compare one shared 4K tile, grouped 4K tiles, then per-MAF tiles; compare physical texel fit, seams, repeat and file count. Solids may share 256 tiles by identical triplet. No production choice implied

maf-pack.calls: atlas_maf.plan_atlas / pack_uniform_tiles for pixel-space trial; vpm_uv for applicable charts and udimtile_core for tile addressing

maf-stubs.gap: Manual RGB triplets by tile: flat DirectX normal, agreed ERM; keep Diffuse alpha where required; confirm placeholder eligibility

maf-sheet.gap: Before/after matched views, source hashes, triangle delta, pixel and physical texel numbers, checker verdict and missing scope

sources-dwg.calls: uv run python tools/methods/body/plan_from_dxf.py (after dwg_to_dxf.py in the AutoCAD lane; Blender-only lane without Autodesk: uv run python tools/methods/body/dxf_intake.py SOURCE.dwg DERIVATIVE.dxf PROVENANCE.json NEW_INTAKE.json first, hash-bound dwg-to-dxf/1 receipt only, converters fail closed [#1857])

body.calls: stage 1 body: uv run agr body PLAN NEW_OUT (shared core tools/methods/body/body_lattice.py in Blender, plan schemas/BodyPlan.schema.json, BM-00 lattice only [#1736]); AGR Tools stages 2-4 in Max [D250]; agr railing SPLINE --type TYPE --out NEW.blend for an approved railing inset (geometry by default; NPM opacity only at budget-ladder)

modelling_split.report_line: Modelling split [D336]: plinth=<one_with_body|inset>; inset=<parts>; texture=<parts>; reason=<why, for this project>
modelling_split.master_checks: element-wise; no check may require welding inset elements into the body

ucx-oks.calls: agr ucx MODEL OUT Main [D330]: build ucx_build, fresh FBX readback, ucx10_core gap check + V010 (gap fix = AGR Tools ucx.gap in Max on an export copy)

master-qa.calls: uv run python tools/qa/master_topology.py MASTER.blend --out NEW.json [D312]

readback.calls: tools/blender/fbx_readback.py; dt qa xview [D152]; stage-2 review views: blender -b SCENE.blend --python tools/blender/stage2_review.py -- NEW_DIR FRAME_ID [ISO_ORTHO_SCALE]

verifier.calls: blender tools/blender/verifier_views.py -- --vpm VPM --npm NPM --out NEW_DIR (6 views), then tools/qa/verifier.py --job jobs/<ID> (observe; vlm_checklist.py variant A + material rubric -> verifier.json); sheet line: tools/qa/verifier_summary.py --sheet-line [#1739]

mesh-quality.ru: Качество сетки бадика в конце body (observe, только запись) [#1739]
mesh-quality.calls: uv run python tools/qa/mesh_quality_observe.py stage MASTER --out NEW/mesh_quality.json (#1616 score + per-facade-cell defect signal #1724; never returns work)

sintez-classify.calls: agr checker summary rules; manual routing by profile, code and actual message

sintez-recipe.gap: one job hook or a manual operation via the current owner; no generic auto-fix

sintez-uv-drift.ru: Проверка UV и регистрации в мире

sintez-sheet.gap: assemble the operator sheet from the two checker reports and the drift receipt

geojson.calls: AGR Tools export.geojson_write (preview/apply); agr validate FILE.geojson --profile vpm (V011)

light-fbx.calls: agr validate ZIP --profile vpm (V012 Light FBX findings; no Blender needed)

derive-npm.calls: agr vpm-to-npm (dt derive atlas, then dt derive npm)

brick-seams.calls: agr brick-seams --config CONFIG.json --out NEW.json (tools/materials/brick_seams.py: course/panel seam candidate plan only; no bitmap bake, native mutation or delivery acceptance)

build-manifest.calls: agr build-manifest record EXPORTED --master MASTER --out NEW.json

review-scene.ru: Сцена для приёмки: копия в C:/x/review-<job>/, новый Max 2026, Blender если Max занят [D255, D270] (#1740)
review-scene.calls: agr open-review FILE --open-approved (tools/open_review_scene.py review: copy to C:/x/review-<job>/<stem>_review_vNNN, NEW Max 2026 process; Blender when the max-live lock is held or Max is missing; never the original, lock only read)

lite-route.gap: cell oks-npm-lite has no card and no simplification rule; reuse oks-npm stages after the user defines it

zero.gap: `agr zero` (tools/ground/project_zero.py) only verifies a supplied zero against the export; the boundary and the zero value come from PZU/vertical planning or are asked [D279]

surfaces.ru: Ground из исходных границ покрытий: общие швы, без слоёв (#1738)
surfaces.calls: agr ground site SPEC.json NEW_OUT (params.surfaces=shared: one face per XY, topmost cover, one vertex set per boundary; DXF hatches or typed SPOZU adapter JSON)

quads.gap: new-site cuts/pairing have no command; `dt ground v015` replays Vatutino only

ground-textures.calls: agr ground site SPEC.json NEW_OUT (cover ID 1..10 -> UDIM 1001-1010, materials from the spec; flat stage first [D293])

relief.calls: agr ground site SPEC.json NEW_OUT (projection on the relief marks after the flat stage [D293]; SM_<site>_Ground.obj)

skirt.ru: Юбка Ground >= 1 м, проверка на экспорте (#1738)
skirt.calls: agr ground site (ground_cake.add_skirt along every outer edge, D251) + ground_site.skirt_check_export on the written OBJ (geometry only)

ucx-ground.calls: agr ucx MODEL OUT Ground [D330]: build ucx_build, fresh FBX readback, ucx10_core gap check + V010

library.ru: МАФ и Флора из библиотеки, атласы

maf-light.calls: agr npm-light SPEC.json --out NEW_DIR (dt derive maf-npm-light, tools/library/maf_npm_light.py, #1410): NPM-light version + atlas UV, silhouette gate

flora-star.calls: uv run python tools/flora/build_flora_star.py --spec SPEC.json --out NEW_DIR (approved map pair); place with engine.place for NPM-only calculation; agr place via src/dt_ai/placement/site.py wraps it for paired NPM + VPM only

optimise.ru: Бюджет НПМ Ground: распределение по МАФ / Флоре
optimise.gap: no ProOptimizer step (Artem 2026-11-21, #1737); Flora/MAF budget split choices stay with Artem [D167]; OKS tris budget goes by the vpm-to-npm budget-ladder

tris-count.calls: uv run python tools/derive/vpm_to_npm.py --job jobs/<ID> --out NEW_DIR (vpm_npm_core.count_tris)

remove-interiors.ru: Удаление интерьеров (внутренние стенки капсул, интерьерные UDIM) — всегда

atlas.ru: Атлас НПМ, вся геометрия на атлас (Unwrap to Atlas / atlas.npm)
atlas.calls: agr vpm-to-npm (dt derive atlas --copied-udims --glass-white, then dt derive npm)

glass-merge.ru: Стекло одним объектом на чисто белых пикселях атласа
glass-merge.calls: master-copy hook, then export_npm.map_white_glass via agr vpm-to-npm

budget-ladder.ru: Лестница бюджета: цилиндры -> плоскости opacity -> плоскости окон, только если всё ещё выше бюджета
budget-ladder.calls: tools/derive/vpm_to_npm.py (vpm_npm_core.budget_ladder; reports ran / skipped / missing steps)

intake.calls: agr library publish BATCH (stage 1: publish.intake_batch; batch copy only, every file an object file or a reported drop)

identify.ru: Дубль / вариант / новый по единой библиотеке
identify.calls: publish.identify_object on library/assets/maf_unified.json (A101 + legacy) via assets_library article/maker keys and intake_identify.dims_check

name.calls: publish.library_name: Manufacturer_NameLatin_Article (assets_library.propose_maf_name, translit, ё=е); else AGR_<kind>_<Name>_<NNN>

qa.ru: Проверка ВПМ и НПМ библиотечного объекта
qa.calls: publish.qa_object on tools/blender/fbx_readback.py reports (blender_runner) + twinqa.maf_checks.maf_findings; pivot/seating per kind

register.ru: Запись версии vNNN и черновика каталога [D370][D371]
register.calls: publish.register_version: AGR-assets/<kind>/<name>/vNNN/ (new version, never overwritten) + draft record in library/published/catalogue.json, visible to agents at once [D421]; publish.rebuild_index rebuilds library/assets/maf_unified.json at the end of every publish|accept|reject

sheet.ru: Лист превью партии для Артёма; accept/reject
sheet.calls: publish.write_sheet per batch; agr library accept NAMES --words | agr library reject NAME --words
